capabilities: Periodically fetch a random top story from HackerNews
Display stories in a sidebar pane
Save a story as a note for later revisiting
extras: The README includes a privacy section stating it only makes GET requests to hacker-news.firebaseio.com with no client-side data, and the author invites sponsorships.
intentEvidence: I thought of creating a plugin similar to the YCombinator Plugin to fetch random top story from HackerNews
motivation: The author used the YCombinator Plugin on BitBar on Mac to see one top story in the menu bar; after switching to Windows and finding no similar utility, he built the equivalent inside Obsidian.
problem: Staying updated with HackerNews stories requires leaving Obsidian, and tools like the BitBar YCombinator widget are not available on all platforms.

relations.evidence: On Mac, I used YCombinator Plugin on BitBar, which is very similar

summary: Sidebar pane that periodically fetches a random top story from HackerNews and can save a story as a note.
